Package hadur2.core.model

Class BotEvent.HitRobot

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.model.BotEvent.HitRobot
All Implemented Interfaces:
BotEvent
Enclosing interface:
BotEvent
public static final class BotEvent.HitRobot extends Object implements BotEvent
We collided with another robot. Both robots lose collision damage, so the energy ledger books it against the duel opponent's next drop, which must not be read as a shot (WAVE-1).
